title: Team roles and responsibilities
text: Current team responsibilities confirmed by Namdev Tukaram Shirodkar on 14 September 2026. These assignments replace earlier team-role summaries in the current project documentation.

Namdev Tukaram Shirodkar · Overall lead · AMR strategy, software & AI. Builds and integrates AI into AMReye.AI, develops new ideas, and connects technology with scientific workflows. Leads AMR strategy and software development while guiding the team’s overall direction and the platform’s technical and scientific integrations.

Tanishq Chari · Co-founder · Hardware & technical lead. Leads hardware development, prototype architecture, system integration and technical feasibility. Coordinates the engineering work needed to turn the platform’s concepts into testable systems.

Mahima Naik · External relations lead · Spokesperson. Serves as the team’s primary spokesperson. Leads external meetings, builds relationships with prospective partners and institutions, and coordinates external communications.
Heramb Prabhu Desai · Marketing & competition Q&A. Handles marketing and prepares the team for questions from judges and audiences. Leads Q&A responses during competitions, pitches and quizzes.

Vishwajit Malik · Business operations & management lead. Coordinates business operations, people, administration and team support. Builds the management processes and internal organisation needed as the startup grows.
